faq.a: Abdulsalam is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ السَّلَام, whose core sense is abdulsalam; servant of peace.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulsalam?
faq.a: Abdulsalam is associated with Arabic. Abdulsalam is Arabic عَبْدُ السَّلَام (ʿAbd al-Salām), meaning 'servant of Peace'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ السَّلَام is Arabic.
Abdulsalam can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulsalam should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Salām is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdulsalam mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Abdulsalam is rendered عبدالسلام and carries the sense عبدالسلام، سلام کا بندہ.

faq.q: What does Abdulsalam mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdulsalam is rendered عبدالسلام and carries the sense عبدالسلام، بنده سلام.
A romanized syllable approximation is ab-dul-sa-lam. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Abdulsalam?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdulsalam, abdulsalam. Script forms are عبدالسلام, عَبْدُ السَّلَام, अब्दुस्सलाम.

faq.q: Is Abdulsalam a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
